176-728-4875.easyPrerequisites:
Conspiracy has any type chosen that isn't "Spirit".
You control another creature.
176-728-4875.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Requiem Angel triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token. The token won't be a Soldier due to Conspiracy.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Fable of the Mirror-Breaker // Reflection of Kiki-Jiki

2105-3337-7025.easyPrerequisites: Reflection of Kiki-Jiki does not have summoning sickness.
2105-3337-7025.description:
Activate Reflection of KIki-Jiki by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant with haste.
Declare Combat Celebrant token as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
When you attack, Avatar Roku and the Combat Celebrant token trigger.
Resolve the token's trigger, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve Avatar Roku's trigger, adding mana.
Repeat.

553-1927-7468.description:
During the opponent's end step immediately before your turn, cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W} using Vedalken Orrery.
In response, cast Swat Away by paying its mana cost, putting Approach of the Sun on top of your library.
In your draw step, draw Approach of the Second Sun.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, winning the game.

338-549-2685-5641.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-549-2685-5641.description:
Gain life in any way.
Basking Broodscale triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Biotransference.
Teething Wurmlet triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

2946-4556-4871-5686.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2946-4556-4871-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Blight Mound trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1368-2033-6321-7296.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-2033-6321-7296.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

1368-2033-3499-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-2033-3499-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

193-2369-2724-3080-5299.description:
Cast Exchange of Words by paying {1}{U}{U}.
When Exchange of Words enters, it triggers, exchanging the text boxes of itself and Wormfang Manta.
Activate Aminatou's first ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing you to loot.
Activate Aminatou's second ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Exchange of Words.
When Exchange of Words leaves the battlefield, its ability from Wormfang Manta's textbox triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
When Exchange of Words enters, it triggers, exchanging the text boxes of itself and Wormfang Manta.
Repeat from step 3 each turn.

713-2034--5.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Surrak and Goreclaw triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Repeat

4217-6556-7300.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures with power 4 or greater.
4217-6556-7300.description:
Cast Airbender's Reversal by paying its mana cost reduced by Temur Battlecrier, targeting any applicable target(s).
Holding priority, cast Lutri by paying its mana cost reduced by Temur Battlecrier.
When Lutri enters, it triggers, copying Airbender's Reversal targeting Lutri.
Resolve Airbender's Reversal, airbending Lutri.
Holding priority, cast Lutri from exile by paying {0} due to Temur Battlecrier.
Repeat from step 3.

1563-2457-4365-7297.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

1494-3887-4613-7152.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill The Thing.
1494-3887-4613-7152.description:
Cast Lab Rats with buyback by paying {4}{B}, returning it to your hand.
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Thing's first ability triggers, putting four +1/+1 counters on it.
Declare The Thing as an attacker. Its second ability triggers, causing you to pay {R}{G}{W}{U} to double the number of +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate The Thing using Sage of Hours' ability by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
1494-3887-4613-7152.notes: You can cast any noncreature spell in lieu of Lab Rats. Lab Rats is strongly recommended as it guarantees you can cast a noncreature spell each turn, but you may omit it at your discretion.

343-1144-2645-6871.description:
Activate Staff of Domination by tapping it, adding {G} as it's a Forest land due to Toph and Yavimaya.
Regal Behemoth triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

11-2928-3258-7089.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Fire Lord Azula
11-2928-3258-7089.description:
Declare Fire Lord Azula as an attacker, triggering its firebending ability, adding {R}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Beacon of Tomorrows by paying its mana cost.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Beacon of Tomorrows.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting the original Beacon of Tomorrows spell.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Narset's Reversal, targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, causing you to copy Narset's Reversal targeting the original Beacon of Tomorrows spell, and then return the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying Beacon of Tomorrows and returning the original Beacon of Tomorrows to your hand.
Resolve both copies of Beacon of Tomorrows from steps 3 and 7, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Repeat during your second extra turn.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-5078-6766.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Repeat

275-4936-5630-6462.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Moss-Pit Skeleton triggers, putting it from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters the battlefield, Transplant Theorist and Cloakwood Swarmkeeper trigger.
Resolve the Transplant Theorist trigger, drawing Moss-Pit Skeleton from your library, and then discarding it.
Resolve the Cloakwood Swarmkeeper trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.

678-5670-6752.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand that can be cast using one colored mana with the mana to cast it.
678-5670-6752.description:
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Haliya triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the creature.
When the creature dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters, Haliya triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

488-1482-4708-4986-5754.notablePrerequisites: One of either Dark Sphere or Jeweled Lotus must be in your hand, with the other in your graveyard.
488-1482-4708-4986-5754.description:
Cast the artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Phlage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Phlage enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities and Loran trigger.
Resolve the first Phlage trigger, sacrificing it.
Resolve the second Phlage trigger, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to gain 3 life.
Resolve the Loran trigger, returning the other {0} cost artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the spell cast in step 1.
Activate the {0} cost artifact by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

643-1789-5231-5649.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters the battlefield, Lathliss triggers.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1349-3967-6012.notablePrerequisites:
There is a coin counter on any creature you control except Athreos.
You control at least one additional nontoken creature if Reluctant Role Model is the only creature you control with a coin counter on it.
1349-3967-6012.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature with a coin counter on it.
When the creature dies, Athreos's second ability and Reluctant Role Model's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Reluctant Role Model trigger, putting a coin counter on it if it wasn't the creature that was sacrificed, or another nontoken creature you control otherwise.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

1409-1753-2933-5798.easyPrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator paired with Drowner of Hope.
1409-1753-2933-5798.description:
Activate Drowner of Hope by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Drowner of Hope trigger, creating two 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Drowner of Hope.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Optimus Prime, Hero // Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader

2018-5226-5263.description:
Activate Lithatog's first ability by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Hero.
When Optimus Prime, Hero dies, its second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
Activate Lithatog's first ability by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
When Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Optimus Prime from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Hero with a flying counter on it.
Resolve both Lithatog abilities from steps 1 and 3, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1479-4677-4826-5700-5701.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-4677-4826-5700-5701.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Zendikar's Roil trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Zendikar's Roil trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Zendikar's Roil triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Zendikar's Roil trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Zendikar's Roil triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

144-2921-5434.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2 greater than the largest life total among your opponents.
144-2921-5434.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Ashcloud Phoenix.
When Ashcloud Phoenix dies, its first ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Ashcloud Phoenix.
Yarus' second ability triggers, returning Ashcloud Phoenix from your graveyard to the battlefield face down, and then turning it face up.
Ashcloud Phoenix's second ability triggers, dealing 2 damage to each player.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1164-2003-2056-2575.description:
Cast Temporal Mastery by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Saheeli triggers, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve Temporal Mastery, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and exile it.
Activate Contagion Engine by paying {6} and tapping it, putting two loyalty counters on Saheeli.
Activate Saheeli by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing the Servo to become a copy of Mirror of Fate until end of turn.
Activate the Servo by tapping and sacrificing it, choosing Temporal Mastery and up to six other cards face up in exile, then exiling your library and putting the chosen cards on top of your library, with Temporal Mastery being the top most card.
Move to your next turn, drawing Temporal Mastery during your draw step.
Repeat.

2882-3079-4999-5231.notablePrerequisites:
Infinite Reflection attached to any creature you control that does not have a cycling ability.
You have discarded at least two cards this turn.
2882-3079-4999-5231.description:
Cast Hollow One either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying at most {1}, causing it to enter the battlefield as a copy of the creature with Infinite Reflection attached.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Hollow One, adding {R}.
If you cast Hollow One from your graveyard, Hollow One is not exiled by Abandoned Sarcophagus due to Infinite Reflection removing Hollow One's cycling ability.
Repeat.
If you have discarded three or more cards this turn, this combo nets infinite red mana.

1558-2963-4321-4840.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Teleportation Circle triggers, blinking Myr Battlesphere.
When Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating four 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens and a Food artifact token due to Peregrin Took.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing the Food and Myrs, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

606-1267-4345-4941-4946.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
606-1267-4345-4941-4946.description:
On the end step prior to your turn, cast True Polymorph by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing Medomai to become a copy of Eye of Vecna.
Activate The Book of Vile Darkness by tapping it and exiling it, Medomai and Hand of Vecna, causing you to create a legendary 8/8 Vecna token that has all triggered abilities of the exiled cards.
During your next turn, deal combat damage to an opponent using Vecna.
Vecna triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 3 during each of your turns.

739-2798-3350-4827.notablePrerequisites: You have Gideon of the Trials' emblem.
739-2798-3350-4827.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Axis of Mortaility triggers.
Holding priority, activate Evra by paying {4}.
Cast Humble by paying {1}{W}, causing Evra to have base power and toughness 0/1 until end of turn.
Resolve Evra's ability, swapping your life total with Evra's power.
Resolve the Axis of Mortality trigger, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero life.

232-586-1980-2493-2596.description:
Cast Living Death by paying {3}{B}{B}.
Swarm Intelligence triggers, copying Living Death.
Resolve the copy of Living Death, exiling all creature cards in all graveyards, then causing each player to sacrifice all creatures they control, then putting all creatures exiled this way onto the battlefield.
Resolve Living Death, exiling all creature cards in all graveyards, then causing each player to sacrifice all creatures they control, then putting all creatures exiled this way onto the battlefield.
Archaeomancer, Priest of Gix, and Priest of Urabrask enter the battlefield, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Archaeomancer trigger, returning Living Death from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1074-1651-3263-4241.notablePrerequisites: One of your opponents controls a creature.
1074-1651-3263-4241.description:
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping itself and King Macar, untapping King Macar.
King Macar triggers, exiling any creature an opponent controls and creating a Gold token.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Gold token and King Macar, targeting King Macar.
Holding priority, activate the Gold token by sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Activate Karn by paying {1}, causing target noncreature permanent an opponent controls to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Resolve the Clock of Omens ability, untapping King Macar.
Repeat from step 2.

3147-4222-4348.notablePrerequisites:
Ley Druid does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Ley Druid.
3147-4222-4348.description:
Activate Azorius Chancery by tapping it, adding {W}{U}.
Activate Ley Druid by tapping it, untapping Azorius Chancery.
Activate Freed from the Real's last ability by paying {U}, untapping Ley Druid.
Repeat any number of times.

432-1687.description:
Cast Shielded by faith by paying {1}{W}{W}, targeting Siona.
Siona triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier token.
Shielded by Faith triggers, causing you to attach it to the new token.
Repeat from step 2.
